item.title: A BFT ordering service for Fabric, and the library under it
item.description: Fabric’s ordering service receives endorsed transactions from clients and emits a stream of blocks. When we wrote this paper the latest release, v2.3, ran it on Raft, which tolerates crashes and nothing worse. The paper describes how my co-authors and I made Fabric Byzantine fault-tolerant end to end: a consensus library in Go, based on the BFT-SMaRt protocol, and the changes to the orderer, the peer and the client that had to come with it.
